# Getting help

Start with [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md) for the workflow index, package layout, and validation commands. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for making changes.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/YourAKShaw/principal-engineer-os/issues) before opening a report. Use the bug, improvement, or documentation form when one fits. For a usage question, open a blank issue with a clear question, what you tried, the relevant files, and your host/model or Python environment where applicable.

Share only sanitized examples. Do not post credentials, private source code, or sensitive vulnerability details in public issues. Host application or model problems may need to be reported to that provider; include enough context to distinguish them from this skill's guidance.
